note: Ground punch from side control, keyed against the pose it is thrown from. Lying across him his chest is flat: its forward points down at the mat and its up points along the mat towards his own head. The mount's clip cocks the hand 0.82 'up' in that frame, which from here is 82 cm out past his own head, and the arm orbited the shoulder to reach it — forward, behind him, down, out and back. From side control it is a short shot anyway: the hand comes off him a little, turns over, and drops back down into the face on the head side. The elbow stays poled out to his side throughout, where side control already holds it.

keys.note: cocked: off him by 20 cm, no more — there is nowhere to wind up from here
down into the face, which is on the head side of him
